title: Chapter 110 What Is Invincible?
content:
Chapter 110 What Is Invincible?

At the same time, in a certain starry sky.

Lu Daosheng watched all this silently.

The system is right, my wife is really strong.

Lu Daosheng also knows Yan Lingyun's personality. She is a very stubborn person. Once she decides about something, it will be difficult to change it again.

Just like Yan Lingyun recognized him at the beginning.

Looking up at the end of the sky, Lu Daosheng's expression became colder and colder, and the murderous intent in his eyes finally exploded at this moment.

In an instant, the entire starry sky was shattered, and endless blood-red murderous intent filled the sky.

"The Holy Land of Fairy Spirit, haha, from now on, there is no need to exist anymore."

Lu Daosheng said in a deep voice, then looked into the distance.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly disappeared from the spot.

If it weren't for the fact that he hadn't been completely awake, when Gongsun Mo just arrived here, Lu Daosheng would have wiped it out directly.

Seeing that his wife had taken action, Lu Daosheng gave up.

......

"Spiritual rhyme."

At this time, Yan Lingyun, who was walking in the starry sky, heard the familiar shouts behind her and stopped.

Turning his head and looking at him, he saw Lu Daosheng with a slightly red face.

Yan Lingyun's eyebrows were slightly frowned.

This guy has drunk so much wine again.

"Is there anything wrong?"

Yan Lingyun pretended to be cold and spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said directly: "Lingyun, I know everything, you don't have to lie to me anymore."

"I didn't understand what you were saying."

Yan Lingyun felt a little uneasy, but she continued to pretend.

However, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

"Lingyun, you left the door of rebirth in the Hongmeng Universe, right?"

"You did the blockade near the Xuanling Star Domain. What I said is correct?"

The door of rebirth had already existed before Yan Lingyun appeared, but the door of rebirth had the breath of Yan Lingyun. Obviously, Yan Lingyun had already been planning a long time ago.

But maybe even Yan Lingyun himself did not expect that after he was reincarnated, he would meet Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun was silent.

Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun and whispered: "Lingyun, I am no longer the young man who only knew how to hide behind you and talk freely."

"I am now capable of facing any difficulties."

At this time, Yan Lingyun's expression also changed, no longer being as cold as before. She looked at Lu Daosheng and said with a complicated expression: "Daosheng, you don't know what I am facing."

"Do you know the powerful man from the Holy Land not long ago? He is even just an ant in front of the existence I want to face."

She knew that Lu Daosheng was very extraordinary now, but it was far from enough.

In her consciousness, Lu Daosheng is on the fifth floor, while she is on the hundredth floor.

But little did he know that Lu Daosheng was already in the atmosphere!

"So what?"

Lu Daosheng said indifferently.

Seeing Lu Daosheng like this, Yan Lingyun shook her head and said that it was useless no matter how much she said. It was not that she looked down on Lu Daosheng, but that those who were really far away for Lu Daosheng now.

To be precise, there is no comparison at all.

At this time, Lu Daosheng nodded.

It is meaningless to say too much. If you want to let your arrogant wife understand clearly, you can only demonstrate it yourself.

"System, show my wife a trick and ask me to take my wife to pretend to be a pussy."

【Received, host is big】

The next moment, Lu Daosheng's aura suddenly changed.

Lu Daosheng's aura suddenly rose with a surge in the sky. In an instant, countless void cracks began to spread rapidly in all directions with Lu Daosheng as the center.

In front of him, Yan Lingyun looked slightly shocked.

Countless powerful people in the star field looked here, with deep fear and horror in their eyes.

What's wrong with this world?

Where did so many terrifying strong men pop up?

At this time, Lu Daosheng changed again, and a strong fairy aura overflowed from Lu Daosheng's body.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun was moved.

Become an immortal on the spot!

And there is no obstacle.

"Lingyun, come on, I'll take you to see what invincibility is."

At this time, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand towards Yan Lingyun and spoke.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Daosheng, was silent for a moment, and slowly reached out to hold Lu Daosheng.

Holding the delicate jade hand in his hand, Lu Daosheng finally showed a long-lasting smile.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly soared into the sky with Yan Lingyun.

Buzz —

Rumble!

At this time, a barrier represented by the supreme rules appeared in front of him, blocking Lu Daosheng's way.

However, Lu Daosheng punched casually and the entire barrier suddenly broke through a hideous hole.

Countless auras of destruction continued to slowly overflow from it.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun's face changed.

"If you break this barrier, the entire lower realm will suffer."

When Lu Daosheng heard his wife's words, he laughed.

"Don't worry, Lingyun, I can break it and make up for it!"

Immediately, Lu Daosheng took Yan Lingyun through the hole, turned around and reached out and said, "Ning!"

The next moment, countless rules began to condense towards the broken hole, but in a blink of an eye, the hole disappeared and the barrier returned to peace.

"this,,"

Yan Lingyun was a little stunned when she saw this method.

At this time, Lu Daosheng pulled her to continue to go deeper.

Through the endless void, Lu Daosheng finally arrived.

Immortal Realm!

At this moment, Lu Daosheng has brought Yan Lingyun to the Immortal Realm.

However, this place does not seem to be the Wood Immortal Realm.

Because Lu Daosheng broke in by force in another way, the void was disordered, and he was a little confused about the direction, which made Lu Daosheng come here unexpectedly.

Golden Immortal Realm!

The Golden Immortal Realm is more powerful than the Wood Immortal Realm. Here, it is no exaggeration to say that there are immortal kings everywhere and immortal masters are as numerous as dogs.

But it doesn't matter where it is.

At most, it will destroy the Immortal Holy Land later.

The most urgent thing is to let his wife understand his strength first.

Boom!

At this time, Lu Daosheng was shocked and the supreme breath burst out.

And this breath did not mean to stop at all, but continued to spread, as if announcing the entire Immortal Realm.

In just a moment, countless top powerhouses woke up and kept looking here.

What a terrifying powerhouse!

The entire Golden Immortal Realm was shaken. This breath was even more terrifying than the breath of a strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Could it be that a terrifying existence above the Immortal Emperor Realm appeared!

But as far as they knew, there was no existence above the Immortal Emperor Realm in the Golden Immortal Realm.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's consciousness swept across the entire Golden Immortal Realm unscrupulously, and his eyes immediately looked at a certain place in the Golden Immortal Realm.

In a stone tower, a white-haired man with an ancient breath suddenly opened his eyes. In his eyes, it seemed that countless stars in the sky were condensed. With just one glance, he passed through the layers of void and met Lu Daosheng's eyes.

"What do you mean?"

The white-haired man frowned slightly and asked slowly.

He had been hiding in the world for endless years, but he was discovered today, and the other party's breath was so amazing.

After so many years, has such a strong person appeared in the outside world?

Hearing the white-haired man's question, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled lightly: "It doesn't mean anything. I just want to prove what is invincible."

Invincible!

To be honest, most of these two words are just exaggerated.

Because no one can be truly invincible, there are always people who are better than you, and being invincible is just a short-sighted person who has never seen a stronger person.

But at this time, Lu Daosheng said this arrogantly.

After all, Lu Daosheng is not a serious practitioner, but a cheater.

And this sentence was not concealed at all, and the voice was not loud, but it spread throughout the entire Golden Immortal Realm.

Hearing this, countless practitioners changed their attitudes and sneered.

"Invincible, what a joke?"

"Tsk, you are so arrogant just because you have a little strength, wait to be slapped in the face."

"Haha, I laugh too hard."

Hearing the word invincible, people naturally don't believe it.

However, at this time, Lu Daosheng's courage infected countless practitioners. Although they didn't know whether Lu Daosheng was invincible or not, Lu Daosheng dared to shout it out, so his strength would naturally not be bad.
